visualCharacteristics: Product hero: a large product image beside a content column with the product name, a tab strip that toggles between Description and Nutrition Facts panels, and a CTA button. Stacks vertically on mobile, side-by-side on desktop.
contentPattern: Rows: an image-only row (hero media), a heading-only row (product name), one row per tab as [label, content] (e.g. Description, Nutrition Facts), and a final link-only row (CTA).
usage: Product detail hero on 7up product pages (e.g. /en/products/7up).
